title: Un-carrier Brand Guidelines
slide_intent: Establish the identity before explaining its rules so a reader recognizes the document as an expression of the brand.
strategic_value: The dominant magenta field and oversized T-Digit can make the guide itself reinforce T-Mobile recognition.
demonstration: A white stacked title and small wordmark occupy the left of a magenta cover; a large white T-Digit fills the right.
practical_value: Use the cover to compare the wordmark as a signature with the T-Digit as the main visual subject.

content_islands.name: Title and edition
content_islands.spec: Place the wordmark above the left-aligned title and the February 2024 edition below it.

content_islands.name: Hero T-Digit
content_islands.spec: Fill the right half with a white T-Digit on the uninterrupted magenta field.
